QUESTION:
What is the recommended starting dose of Amoxicillin?

RESPONSE:
The recommended starting dose of amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium for oral suspension (600 mg/42.9 mg per 5 mL) for pediatric patients aged 3 months to 12 years weighing ≤40 kg is 90 mg/kg/day of the amoxicillin component, divided into two doses (every 12 hours) and administered for 10 days. The medication should be taken at the start of a meal to minimize gastrointestinal intolerance and enhance absorption. Please note this labeling is specific to this particular formulation and indication (recurrent or persistent acute otitis media with specific risk factors). For other indications or patient populations, different dosing may apply.
